contact_edits.before: The National Home Show, presented by ReMax, opens today and runs to April 17 at the National Trade Centre, Exhibition Place. Includes more than 800 exhibitors, a concept home, professional renovators and such celebrities as Mike Holmes, Debbie Travis and Evan Farmer. Weekdays from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m., Saturday from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m., Sunday to 6 p.m. Adults $13, seniors and youth $8, children 12 and under are free. 416-385-1880. www.nationalhomeshow.com.
